title: Bipartite Battle
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: Two players alternately delete one vertex or one edge from any still non-empty graph among N drawn bipartite graphs, the i-th having parts of a_i and b_i vertices, and whoever cannot move loses. The task counts, modulo 1000000007, the ways to draw the edge sets so that the second player wins under optimal play, with N up to 100000 and part sizes up to 1000000000.
